title: UNIVERSAL MUSIC REPRESENTATIONS? EVALUATING FOUNDATION MODELS ON WORLD MUSIC CORPORA
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical capabilities and cross-cultural generalization of audio foundation models (such as Qwen2-Audio and MERT) for music tagging. While it explores cultural diversity and Western-centric bias in these models, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
